text: I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation here. The openness of the first space, with its modern design and emptiness, invites contemplation—almost as though I am on the threshold of thought before action. The second space, rich in color and information, feels stimulating and instructive. The "R+D" theme calls me to reflect on progress and the interplay between research and possibility. Both spaces, tilted and visually dynamic, nudge me to question my usual perspectives.
